title: fix: ioctl_key_export_private returns raw wolfCrypt error not kernel errno on FIPS gate
description: ioctl_key_export_private uses ret=state->key_ops->fips_gate() then goto out, propagating the wolfCrypt error code directly to userspace instead of mapping to -EACCES. This violates the return-code discipline in CLAUDE.md. All other FIPS gate failure paths in crypto2dev_fd.c explicitly set ret=-EACCES. Found during WOLFKM-6vs review.
